items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
items.claim: The law of the burnt offering prescribes that it be burned upon the altar all night unto the morning with fire burning continuously.
items.mechanism: the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it
